result.detail: Board "esp32" runs via the arduino-esp32 snapshot profile, which stubs HardwareSerial::write / uartWrite. A serial oracle can never pass here — the twin only proves itself by panel paint (display oracle), GPIO/register clauses, or by rebuilding on esp32-c3-supermini / esp32-s3-zero where ROM boot captures UART0. Do not wait for no_paint; change the oracle or the board.

gaps.detail: classic ESP32 profile does not capture Serial
